now_the_spec_says: A SIEVE IS ONE TRUE/FALSE RULE. It evaluates true or false on whatever it inspects, and it is specific to the DEVICE inspected. That is the whole definition. No bands, no ladder, no ordering, no nest, no gradation: each sieve is independent, nothing to stack or sequence.
